project_type: French-language Flask web app (agricultural RAG advisor for Burkina Faso) with offline evaluation tooling
language: Python (3.11 expected; repo uses str | None union syntax that requires 3.10+) plus JavaScript (node --test)
build_system: pip + requirements.txt for Python; pnpm for JS. Repo expects a local .venv used by verification commands (.venv/bin/pytest, .venv/bin/python).
test_framework: pytest for Python (tests/ dir, no conftest fixtures needed for K2 suites), node --test for JS (tests/js/*.test.js via `pnpm test:js`, devDependency jsdom).
build_command: python3.11 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt ; pnpm install
verification_instructions: Run exactly: (1) .venv/bin/pytest -q tests/test_farmer_evaluation.py tests/test_evidence_ledger.py tests/test_evaluate_rag.py ; (2) .venv/bin/pytest -q tests --ignore=tests/test_rag.py ; (3) pnpm test:js ; (4) git diff --check. tests/test_rag.py is excluded because it needs Groq/HF network.
snapshot_or_generated_files: static/data/fertilizer.json is generated by scripts/export_offline_fertilizer.py and checked in; K2 must NOT change it (do not touch fertilizer guidance). No snapshot regen needed for K2.
setup_instructions: System python3 is 3.9 which is too old (union syntax). Use pyenv python3.11 (available at /root/.pyenv/shims/python3.11): python3.11 -m venv .venv; .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt. Node 22 + pnpm 10 available; run `pnpm install` first.
environment_constraints: Network: OPEN_INTERNET. Do NOT run live evaluation (scripts/evaluate_rag.py against a real host) and do NOT claim it ran. tests/test_rag.py needs live Groq/HF and must be excluded from verification. The scaffold generator must be fully offline and deterministic.
contribution_requirements: Operating rules from plans/KIRO_IMPROVEMENT_PLAN_2026-09-17.md: one focused branch + one draft PR per task, do NOT merge/push here (orchestrator publishes). Keep user-facing text in French. Blank human fields stay blank, pending gates stay pending, missing evidence keeps release decision at REPORTE. NUMERIC_GUIDANCE_VERIFIED stays False. Preserve safety refusals. Append decisions to SESSION.md after major steps (AGENTS.md convention; SESSION.md is large ~106KB).
key_patterns: scripts/farmer_evaluation.py already has: assess() scorecard screening with split separation, assess_claims() using claims as denominator requiring >=90%, assess_tasks() using participant x task observations requiring >=80% each for completed_independently and understood_next_action, plus prepare_* generators. Corpus identity via core.rag_pipeline.build_source_manifest (sha256 per file). Policy revision via core.answer_safety.safety_policy_revision() => 'safety-2026-09-09.<digest>'. Model config via config.LLM_MODEL/GEMINI_MODEL/EMBEDDING_MODEL. Commit via `git rev-parse HEAD`. Dated-artifact convention: evaluation/PILOT_REHEARSAL_CHECKLIST_2026-09-12.md, Data/reviews/*_2026-09-*.md. RELEASE_DECISION_TEMPLATE.md is the French template the scaffold should follow (gates table with denominators/thresholds, REPORTE default). There is NO existing release-decision generator script yet; K2 must add one.
directory_structure: evaluation/ = release-evaluation artifacts + benchmark; scripts/ = evaluation and export tools (farmer_evaluation.py, evaluate_rag.py); core/ = app logic (source_policy, fertilizer, retrieval, rag_pipeline, answer_safety, case_log); tests/ = pytest suites + tests/js for node tests + tests/fixtures. Do NOT modify core/fertilizer.py, core/source_policy.py, static/data/fertilizer.json, Data/reviews/* eligibility.
